events.name: Cincinnati Open
events.summary: A combined ATP Masters 1000 and WTA 1000 tournament, with both draws, daily schedules, rankings and followed-player controls in one place.
details: Community Weekend opened the tournament on 8-9 August before main-draw play began on 11 August.
The event concludes with finals weekend on 22-23 August. Published match times remain subject to the official order of play.

sources.name: ATP Tour — Fils wins the 2026 Cincinnati final
Cincinnati Open — Gauff claims second Cincinnati crown

editorialNarrative.hook: Fils left Cincinnati with a first Masters 1000 title, while Gauff's second crown reopened a proven road from Ohio to New York.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Arthur Fils returned from a long absence to become the youngest French Masters 1000 champion of the series era. Coco Gauff won Cincinnati for the second time and carried a genuine continuity line into the US Open: her first Cincinnati title in 2023 immediately preceded her first major, a precedent rather than a prediction.

events.name: US Open 2026
events.venue: USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center
events.summary: The final Grand Slam of 2026 runs for 22 days, from Fan Week and qualifying through the singles finals at Arthur Ashe Stadium.
details: Fan Week begins on 23 August and main-draw singles begin on 30 August.
The women's singles final is scheduled for 12 September and the men's singles final for 13 September.

subEvents.name: Serena Williams / Carlos Alcaraz v Erin Routliffe / Lloyd Glasspool
subEvents.summary: US Open 2026 · Mixed doubles · Round 1 · Arthur Ashe Stadium.

editorialNarrative.hook: Serena Williams / Carlos Alcaraz and Erin Routliffe / Lloyd Glasspool meet at the first elimination point of the Mixed doubles path.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Serena Williams / Carlos Alcaraz and Erin Routliffe / Lloyd Glasspool meet at the first elimination point of the Mixed doubles path. Alexander Zverev now heads a men's draw whose five former champions all sit in the bottom half, including returning defending champion Carlos Alcaraz. In the women's event, Aryna Sabalenka is chasing a third straight title; alongside that individual history sits the longer American men's drought, unbroken since Andy Roddick in 2003.

editorialNarrative.hook: Carlton's recovery from a one-and-eight start met Melbourne's surprise finals season; the advancing side remains concealed here.

subEvents.name: Sabah v Hapoel Beer-Sheva
subEvents.summary: Hapoel Beer-Sheva lead 2-1 after the first leg.

editorialNarrative.hook: Sabah and Hapoel Beer-Sheva have reached the decisive second leg, with one of the remaining league-phase places attached to the tie.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Sabah and Hapoel Beer-Sheva have reached the decisive second leg, with one of the remaining league-phase places attached to the tie. Qualification filled the final seven places in the 36-team league phase, with LASK producing the stage's lasting recovery: a 5–1 extra-time return-leg win after losing 3–0 at Celtic. Sabah and Slovan Bratislava also survived extra time, and all seven winners now persist as named entrants in the next phase rather than disappearing with the completed bracket.

editorialNarrative.hook: Eight matchdays determine which clubs skip February and which must take the knockout play-off route.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Eight matchdays determine which clubs skip February and which must take the knockout play-off route. The league phase asks each of 36 clubs to face eight different opponents across 144 matches. AEK Athens v LASK opens a direct line from qualification, while first-time Champions League entrant LASK and first-time European participant Como enter the same table as back-to-back champion Paris Saint-Germain. The opening story is continuity, not a blank group-stage reset.

editorialNarrative.hook: One match in Madrid decides the European champion after every qualifying and knockout route converges.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: One match in Madrid decides the European champion after every qualifying and knockout route converges. The 36-team league table determines three distinct fates and also shapes play-off seeding. The knockout path begins in February and ends at Estadio Metropolitano, while Paris's pursuit of a third consecutive title remains a live thread rather than an assumed participant outcome.

Drawn matches will become selectable for Fixtures once a stable match identity and published start time are available.

editorialNarrative.hook: Melbourne's three-week tournament returns with two first-time 2026 champions carrying very different title defences into an unknown draw.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Opening Week and the 17–31 January main draw create a three-week arc before the singles finals. Alcaraz and Rybakina return as first-time Australian Open champions, while capped early Ground Passes and the record 2026 audience add a real scale consequence without inventing entrants or seeds.

events.name: Formula 1 Australian Grand Prix 2027
events.summary: The 2027 Australian Grand Prix is confirmed for Albert Park, with race-weekend dates still unpublished on the verified ticket page.
details: The official Formula One ticketing endpoint currently offers a waitlist.
The event date remains TBC until a current Formula One or FIA calendar confirms it.

Albert Park's fast temporary-road character supplies durable context while the card remains explicitly TBC instead of turning a planning date into a fixture.
